notes.title: Trial version Ver. 1.01 update was released on December 12, 2024.
notes.content:
■Update Details
・Adjustment of some English translations
・Implementation of the function to stop or turn off the sound when sending a message.
・Correction of minor bugs

notes.title: Ver1.01 Update
notes.content:
Ver. 1.01 update was released on July 25, 2024.

■Update Details
・Adjustment of some English translations
・Implementation of the function to stop or turn off the sound when sending a message.
・Correction of minor bugs

The save data of the previous version can be transferred.
